verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs mention agent-facing capabilities like 'Create tools for AI agents to interact with your systems' and 'Allow AI agents to deploy a project and let a human take over,' plus agent skill/slash-command support for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), suggesting some official agent-integration surface. However, none of the evidence explicitly names an MCP server, MCP protocol support, or an MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official MCP server/endpoint, MCP protocol naming, or third-party confirmation that agents connect via MCP rather than generic APIs/CLI.
